title: TopologyViewStreamFrame
description: One Server-Sent Event (SSE) frame payload for a resolved topology view stream. Carried in the SSE `data:` line.

type.description: Event type discriminator. Topology artifact streams reuse this envelope and may emit 'overlay_status' for runtime overlay layer health.

seq.description: Per-(viewId,scope) monotonically increasing sequence number for resume.

time.description: UTC timestamp when this frame was emitted.
